limitations: No AFH Sigma-prime, Sigma-double-prime, or Delta nuclear response has been numerically contracted with the three-body tensor.
The coherent point-charge current includes centre-of-mass convection only, not internal nuclear currents of spinful Xe isotopes.
The per-nucleon vN and q/(2mN) factors are kinematic estimates, not AFH nuclear-response ratios.
The chi2 width is conditional on Dirac, real-scalar, pure-scalar and single-open-channel assumptions; the vector self-energy is not included.
The calculation is fixed-speed and single-isotope; no halo, isotope sum, detector response or likelihood is included.
